summary: Stabilis Solutions filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) common stock offering of up to $10.1 million via Johnson Rice. No special situation—this is ordinary shelf takedown. The filing is a routine capital raise; not an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special event. The ATM is incremental to ongoing operations, offering securities according to general instructions Baby Shelf Limitation. The registrant acts as issuer. No deal terms exist for classification.
